shots.name: The Phantom Pocket
shots.text: You reach into your pocket, and it is empty. For ten seconds, a spike of physical panic grips your chest.

shots.name: The Cognitive Amputation
shots.text: You don't just feel like you lost a gadget. You feel as though thirty percent of your memory and navigation was instantly amputated.

shots.name: The Extended Mind Thesis
shots.text: This is the Extended Mind Thesis. When an external tool reliably stores and recalls data, it functions as literal biology.

shots.name: The Silicon Loop
shots.text: Your biological neurons and silicon circuits operate in a continuous loop, thinking together across the boundary of your skin.

shots.name: The Handheld Cyborg
shots.text: You didn't need neural implants to become a cyborg. You became one the moment you offloaded your mind into your hand.
